title: start_run wiring test never arms off-home camera state; routing asserts may pass vacuously
evidence:
+	app.run_live = true // the fixture already run_init'd State — take the clean destroy-then-reinit path
+	app.cat.balance.logic_hz = 20 // the boot wiring reads logic_hz for run_init
+	start_run(&app, 42)
+	testing.expect(t, app.cam_zoom_to == rnd.DEFAULT_ZOOM, "start_run routes the camera to the 2.0 cluster-default home")
+	app.cam_zoom = 4.0
+	app.cam_zoom_to = 4.0
+	app.cam_wx = 999
+	app.cam_wx_to = 999
detail: The sibling tests arm off-home camera state before acting; start_run does not, so its routing asserts depend on unshown fixture defaults and could pass without the routing call — contradicting the header's RED-on-removal claim.
recommended_fix: Set cam_zoom/cam_zoom_to=4.0 and cam_wx_to/cam_wy_to=999 before start_run(&app, 42), matching the sibling tests, so removing the routing call is guaranteed red.

title: The hunk comment misattributes start_run's pullback clear to the destroy-then-reinit; the only clear on that path is the camera_set_default routing call itself
evidence:
Diff comment: `NOTE: start_run clears pullback
via its destroy-then-reinit run-init independent of the camera routing, so
start_run_wiring_homes_on_the_source_cluster pins ONLY the routing`. But grep of start_run's body (main.odin:874-988) finds zero `pullback` references except the camera_set_default call; run_destroy is Run_State-scoped: `run_destroy :: proc(state: ^Run_State)` and never touches App.pullback; the clear lives only in camera_set_default (main.odin:1759-1765): `camera_set_default :: proc(app: ^App) {
	app.cam_wx_to = app.home_wx
	app.cam_wy_to = app.home_wy
	app.cam_zoom_to = rnd.DEFAULT_ZOOM
	app.pullback = false`.
detail: The comment's mechanism claim is false: removing the start_run routing call leaves an armed pullback stale across restart, because run_destroy/run_init never reset App.pullback. Coverage is still safe (home-target asserts go red), but the rationale documented is wrong.
recommended_fix: Correct the comment: the clear rides the camera_set_default routing call (transitively pinned by the routing asserts); the reinit does not reset App.pullback. Optionally arm pullback=true and assert the clear.

title: start_run test comment falsely claims pullback-clear happens independent of the camera routing

title: False comment claim: start_run's pullback-clear is NOT independent of the camera routing — the routing call is the only clear, and the pin is skipped on a false premise
evidence: app/pullback_test.odin:513-515: "// removal of a routing call turns the suite RED. NOTE: start_run clears pullback / // via its destroy-then-reinit run-init independent of the camera routing, so / // start_run_wiring_homes_on_the_source_cluster pins ONLY the routing (the". start_run body (app/main.odin:874-986) contains ZERO other pullback writes (grep 'pullback' = 0 matches); the only clear is inside camera_set_default (app/main.odin:1759-1763): "camera_set_default :: proc(app: ^App) { / app.cam_wx_to = app.home_wx / app.cam_wy_to = app.home_wy / app.cam_zoom_to = rnd.DEFAULT_ZOOM / app.pullback = false / }". Empirical mutation proof (scratch copy, :972 call removed, pullback armed true before start_run): "[pullback_test.odin:531:start_run_wiring_homes_on_the_source_cluster()] PROBE: start_run clears pullback" [ERROR] — pullback stays true across the run boundary; same probe passes green on the clean copy.
detail: run_destroy/run_init touch app.state, never App.pullback. A maintainer trusting the comment could re-route start_run's camera call and silently lose restart's pullback-clear — the exact mutation-blind class this PR pins.
recommended_fix: Arm app.pullback = true before start_run(&app, 42) and assert it clears (verified: passes clean, fails with :972 removed); rewrite the NOTE — the clear comes via the routing call itself.

title: start_run wiring pin omits the pullback-clear assert, justified by a false run-init rationale
evidence: app/pullback_test.odin:513-517: // removal of a routing call turns the suite RED. NOTE: start_run clears pullback / via its destroy-then-reinit run-init independent of the camera routing, so / start_run_wiring_homes_on_the_source_cluster pins ONLY the routing (the / DEFAULT_ZOOM + source-cluster-home asserts) — it does NOT claim to pin / pullback-clear. The effect_cancel and deselect tests ARM pullback=true first — app/main.odin:263: pullback: bool, (an App field) — core/types.odin:561: run_init :: proc(state: ^Run_State, seed: u64, catalog_hash: u64, logic_hz: i32, — run_init/run_destroy take ^Run_State and cannot touch App-owned pullback. Mutation probe (verified live): with main.odin:972 removed, adding app.pullback = true before start_run(&app, 42) leaves app.pullback == true after start_run (TEMP assert fired), so the skipped assert IS mutation-visible.
detail: run_init cannot clear App-owned pullback (main.odin:263). Mutation-verified: with the :972 routing call removed, an armed pullback stays true after start_run — the skipped assert is mutation-visible, so the start_run call site's pullback-clear half is unpinned.
recommended_fix: Arm app.pullback = true before start_run(&app, 42) and assert false after; rewrite the NOTE — the run-boundary clear rides camera_update's post-snap convergence (main.odin:1850), never run-init.
